ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_000
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我回来了——

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_001
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 抱歉，回头见

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊哈，抱歉啦抱歉啦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_003
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊哈，抱歉啦抱歉啦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 抱歉，你能再说一次名字……吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_005
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 抱歉，没什么

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_006
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
我说，那边那个女生。
这里非工作人员禁止入内哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_007
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……朋花。你这就要回去了？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_008
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我，成了一个不努力的人

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_009
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
这样啊。
对了……联系上枣学姐了吗？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_010
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 这次再怎么说都是奏多的错吧？

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_011
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
嗯。以前是我姐练篮球用的……
现在没人用了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
听完刚才那段，
再不让汐见同学唱就太浪费了吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_013
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……你是茉幌的麻烦粉丝？
如果是这样的话，我可不能让你见她呢

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……啊，想起来了。
她就是传闻里那个霸占着天台、谁都不让靠近的学姐

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_015
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 完美啦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_016
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……就是明天了呢，演出

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_017
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 来练习吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_018
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
好好好，大家都这么说。
不过抱歉，演出时间之外都属于私人时间

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_019
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 她……是汐见萤同学

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_020
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: ……茉幌。我来说吧

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_021
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
唉……我知道了啦。
加入是可以，但乐队的事我可不懂哦

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_022
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 啊哈哈。玩乐队就是花钱

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_023
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 奏多说她想到正式的乐队名了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_024
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 乐队……能留住的话，我当然想留住

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_025
ui_voice_tap#2.Text:
……谢谢你。话说，抱歉啊。
打扰你练习了

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_026
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 我的吉他，原本是爸爸的。好像是把好吉他

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 早上去叫茉幌起床，对我来说就像是例行公事一样

ui_voice_tap#2.Name: voice_028
ui_voice_tap#2.Text: 糟了，棒棒糖没库存了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_000
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我回来了——

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_001
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 抱歉，回头见

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_002
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊哈，抱歉啦抱歉啦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_003
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊哈，抱歉啦抱歉啦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_004
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 抱歉，你能再说一次名字……吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_005
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 抱歉，没什么

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_006
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
我说，那边那个女生。
这里非工作人员禁止入内哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_007
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: ……朋花。你这就要回去了？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_008
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我，成了一个不努力的人

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_009
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
这样啊。
对了……联系上枣学姐了吗？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_010
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 这次再怎么说都是奏多的错吧？

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_011
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
嗯。以前是我姐练篮球用的……
现在没人用了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_012
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
听完刚才那段，
再不让汐见同学唱就太浪费了吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_013
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
……你是茉幌的麻烦粉丝？
如果是这样的话，我可不能让你见她呢

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_014
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
……啊，想起来了。
她就是传闻里那个霸占着天台、谁都不让靠近的学姐

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_015
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 完美啦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_016
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: ……就是明天了呢，演出

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_017
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 来练习吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_018
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
好好好，大家都这么说。
不过抱歉，演出时间之外都属于私人时间

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_019
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 她……是汐见萤同学

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_020
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: ……茉幌。我来说吧

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_021
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
唉……我知道了啦。
加入是可以，但乐队的事我可不懂哦

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_022
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 啊哈哈。玩乐队就是花钱

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_023
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 奏多说她想到正式的乐队名了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_024
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 乐队……能留住的话，我当然想留住

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_025
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text:
……谢谢你。话说，抱歉啊。
打扰你练习了

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_026
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 我的吉他，原本是爸爸的。好像是把好吉他

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_027
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 早上去叫茉幌起床，对我来说就像是例行公事一样

heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Name: voice_028
heart_speech_1_1_1#2.Text: 糟了，棒棒糖没库存了
